text:
anya (support): morning — quick triage check. queue: 38 open tickets, 5 flagged P1s (payments x2, embeddings x1, api-gw x2). known issue: embeddings ingestion returning 503s since ~03:10 UTC (ticket #4532). proposing small macro tweak to `embeddings_retries` to add a link to the runbook and backoff note. I'm OOO 11:30-12:30 today.

sam (oncall): on it. I'll take the payments P1s and ping @eng-oncall for API gateway. can you drop a sample log for the embeddings 503s?

anya (support): pasted one below — this is from customer upload flow, compressed for privacy:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:04Z ERROR ingest-service request_id=ae3f4f code=503 msg="upstream timeout" model=embed-large seq=2048
2026-03-17T03:12:05Z WARN  kv-cache miss
2026-03-17T03:12:06Z ERROR ingest-service request_id=ae3f5a code=503 msg="connection reset by peer"
```

maria (support): seeing the same in a couple of customer repros. adding a temp macro note: "If you see 503s after 03:10 UTC, escalate to eng-oncall and attach ingest logs." Should we add the exact timestamps? :thinking_face:

leo (eng): thanks for the logs. looks like upstream model-host timed out under short bursts. I'm rolling a rate-limit soft patch to staging now. will post PR. if rate-limit reduces errors, we can roll to prod with canary.

triage-bot: ALERT 03:14 UTC — embeddings service error rate 18% (baseline 0.3%). linked ticket: #4532. Suggested action: route new uploads to fallback model `embed-small` until rollback/patch.

sam (oncall): good to know. @maria can you update the macro text to include fallback -> `embed-small` and the temporary escalation step? I'll handle routing if leo confirms.

maria (support): drafting macro update now. proposed snippet:
```
- If ingestion returns 5xx/503: retry with exponential backoff (3 tries).
- If error rate >10% for >5min: route to fallback model `embed-small` and ping eng-oncall.
- Attach ingest-service logs and request_id.
```

leo (eng): PR #2345 created with the soft rate-limit (staging). I'll run smoke tests for 10 mins and report.

maria (support): PR LGTM from support perspective, leaving a tiny wording tweak. will push macro PR once leo confirms smoke.

sam (oncall): taking payments P1s now. leaving note on #payment-processor ticket about increased latency — @finance-systems FYI.

anya (support): thanks everyone. timeline: I'll update the public macro after leo's smoke test (aim 03:40 UTC). If smoke fails, sam — please apply fallback routing per triage-bot. back in channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:

leo (eng): smoke looks good so far (03:28 UTC) — error rate down to 1.2%. proceeding to canary prod rollout in 5.

maria (support): macro PR merged and published. updated wording includes fallback and exact escalate steps.

sam (oncall): routing set to fallback for new uploads until canary finishes. monitoring.

anya (support): perfect. closing loop — queue will likely drop after rollout. I'll reopen if we see regressions. thanks all :raised_hands:
